notes: Every offset the master humanoid's weapon holds use, in one place. Canonical: the same numbers for every character and faction on the MASTER_HUMANOID_RIG skeleton (scripts/blender/canonical_skeleton.json); nothing here is per character.

sockets: non-deforming bones' local transforms (metres, parent bone space). RightHandWeaponSocket is where a pistol grip's frame sits in the closed right hand (origin on the grip's centre line at the middle finger, +Y up the grip toward the receiver, +Z forward toward the trigger). LeftHandWeaponSocket is its exact mirror (x, y, z) -> (-x, y, z), (qx, qy, qz, qw) -> (qx, -qy, -qz, qw).
twist: share of the hand's roll about the forearm that ForearmTwist takes, and of the upper arm's roll about itself that UpperArmTwist takes back.

ik: the arm never stretches: past maxReach of (upper + forearm) it stays straight toward the target; maxFlexDeg keeps the elbow from folding through itself. clavicle: a far target draws the shoulder toward it, the clavicle turning up to maxDeg (smoothstep of shoulder->target / arm length between start and full).
torso: how a stance's torso blade is spread over Spine1..3 (spread) and how much of it the neck and head turn back (head: 1 = the face stays where the clip had it).

stances: where the weapon is held, in chest space (Spine3; metres). butt: the weapon's butt point (weapons.<id>.butt) in Spine3 space. rotation [yaw, pitch, roll] deg (yaw + = muzzle to the character's left, pitch + = muzzle up) in the anchor's frame: 'chest' = Spine3's frame (the weapon rides the torso), 'aim' = the character's facing plus the aim pitch (the barrel along the aim line whatever the torso does). poles: each elbow's pole point in Spine3 space (the elbow bends toward it). torso.yaw: the chest's facing relative to the character's (deg, - = to the right: the rifle's bladed stance), whatever the clip's spine yaw (an aim offset); torso.headTilt: [chin down, toward the right shoulder] deg, a cheek on the stock.

gripCorrections: per library pose, the master's own small finger turns after the pose (bone keys Thumb1 ... Pinky3, quaternions in the poses' right-hand convention): its palm and thumb are not the glove's. Canonical, never per character.

fingerBasis: the first-person glove's bind finger rotations (public/hands/arms.glb). The grip pose library (src/config/gripposes.json) is authored on top of them; on the master a finger bone's local rotation is basis (x) pose (left hand: basis.left (x) mirror(pose)), the first-person FingerPoser's rule with the glove's basis.

weapons: weapon-side data in the weapon model's own units and axes (the AK: muzzle +X, up +Y, its right side +Z, ~1 mm per unit). rightGrip: the pistol grip's frame (it lands on RightHandWeaponSocket). leftGrip: Hand_L's frame on the handguard (the support hand's IK target). butt: the butt point the stance places.
